purpose: Preserve 192 attested-not-admitted candidates from old D8 research and 34 historical D9 overflow decisions, without treating old coordinates or old unratified selections as current domain authority.

source_sets.old_statement: 192 attested-not-admitted historical candidates; chronology-per-D6 allocation rule explicitly falsified/demoted
34 old review rows, when D9 was research-unratified: 20 proposed, 11 HOLD, 3 exact lower duplicates

current_exact_name_dedup.rule: Normalized exact-name overlap is only a navigation hint: name overlap is not behavioral equivalence and name absence is not semantic novelty.

invariants: Historical D8 coordinates are preserved only inside historical_snapshot and are not current coordinates.
Historical D9 selected decisions are preserved only inside historical_snapshot; they do not create D10 candidates.
All current selected_d10_candidate flags are false, all current coordinates null, all ratified flags false.
Current D8 is owner-ratified 256/256; old 64-admitted/192-unassigned counts are from a historical research state and do not describe current D8 occupancy.
Current D1-D9 and selected D10 inventories are re-read and exact-name intersections are recomputed by the checker.
No D8 or D9 coordinate or resident table is modified.
